name: playground-yarn-hoisting-lexical
description: A playground to experiment with yarn hoisting behavior with lexical packages
author: Andrew Stegmaier

scripts.retest:windows: npm run reinstall:windows && npm run test
scripts.retest:windows:all: npm run reinstall:windows:all && npm run test
scripts.retest:bash: npm run reinstall:bash && npm run test
scripts.retest:bash:all: npm run reinstall:bash:all && npm run test
scripts.test: npm run test:a && npm run test:b
scripts.clean:windows:all: powershell -Command "Remove-Item -Path 'pnpm-lock.yaml' -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; exit 0" && npm run clean:windows
